# Synthetic repository guardrails demo

This is a public demonstration, not production software. All data must be synthetic.
Use Node.js 22+ and TypeScript with strict types. Run `npm ci` and `npm test`.
Keep the stable workflow job names `CI` and `CodeQL`.

Only implement the bounded issue assigned to you. Do not edit workflows,
repository rules, security configuration, dependencies, or the intentionally
separate security-demo branch unless the issue explicitly requests it.
Do not introduce credentials, customer names, external services, or deployments.
Leave changes in a pull request for an independent human reviewer. Do not merge,
approve your own work, bypass protection, or weaken tests to obtain a pass.
